review.summary: Reviewed the upstream diff, Joolia base-to-previous port, merged result, binding-partition helpers, declaration callers, and existing rebinding/inference coverage. The refactor preserves behavior and introduces no zero-origin conversion requirement; no source or test adaptations were made.

commits.subsystems: Native top-level evaluation and module binding partitions: `src/toplevel.c:293-363` (`jl_declare_global`), `src/builtins.c:1885-1897` (`jl_f_declare_global`), `src/module.c:1932-2008` (`jl_replace_binding_locked`), and partition classification helpers in `src/julia.h` and `src/julia_internal.h`. Related producers and consumers in `src/julia-syntax.scm`, `Compiler/src`, `test/rebinding.jl`, `test/syntax.jl`, and `Compiler/test/inference.jl` were inspected.
commits.indexing_implications: No collection-position arithmetic is changed. `new_world` and `min_world` in `src/toplevel.c:308,327` are world-age/version identifiers and partition boundaries, not indices; `new_world-1` in `src/module.c:2000` closes a world interval and must remain unchanged. `PARTITION_KIND_*` values in `src/julia.h:815-855` are internal enum tags, while `replaced`, `update_partition`, and `update_in_place` are booleans. The resulting code still queries one partition at `new_world`, preserves zero-origin collection behavior elsewhere, and keeps compiler/global binding identifiers in their established representations.
commits.adaptations: None. Comparing `12fbf6b9b315b71aaa96b7a766c5c23c89f36d90` to Joolia base `409b6d13b17dafb9824beb86d8516860f398c2fc` showed no local adaptation in `src/toplevel.c`. The straight-line code preserves the old cases: same weak declaration is a no-op; typed weak declarations are rejected before partition inspection; implicit/guard-to-global transitions either mutate the current-world partition or install a new partition; constants/imports retain their errors; existing typed globals still require `jl_types_equal`; the world counter advances only after replacement. No origin conversion, sentinel change, ABI change, or test weakening is justified.
commits.tests: Recommended, not run in this review job: rebuild the runtime with `make -j8`; run `make -C src analyze-toplevel -j8 --output-sync` after analysis dependencies are available; run `make -C test core-bootstrap base-foundation compiler-foundation`; run `./usr/bin/joolia --startup-file=no --check-bounds=yes test/runtests.jl rebinding syntax`; then run the required `python3 contrib/ci/run.py --jobs 4`. Existing `test/rebinding.jl` partition-kind, typed-global, import, deletion, and precompile cases exercise the relevant transitions; `test/syntax.jl` and `Compiler/test/inference.jl` cover declaration lowering and typed-global inference. Only read-only inspection and `git diff --check` were executed here.
